summary: Roswell Air Center Airport (ROW) is a medium-sized public airport located in Roswell, New Mexico, serving southeastern New Mexico. The facility sits on the former Walker Air Force Base, a Strategic Air Command installation active from 1941 to 1967, and retains one of the longest runways in the southwestern United States. It also supports aircraft manufacturing and the famous Roswell UFO museum tourism.
faqs:
Q: How far is the airport from downtown Roswell?
A: The airport is approximately 7 miles south of downtown Roswell, about a 15-minute drive.

Q: Does Roswell Air Center have commercial airline service?
A: Yes, the airport is served by regional carriers providing scheduled passenger service to connecting hubs.

Q: Is the airport connected to the UFO history of Roswell?
A: The airport sits on the site of the former Walker Air Force Base, which has its own Cold War history; the nearby International UFO Museum and Research Center in downtown Roswell is the main UFO attraction.

Q: Are there car rental services at ROW?
A: Yes, rental car counters are available in the terminal building for major providers.
transport_tips: Rental cars and taxis are the most convenient options, as there is no public transit directly serving the airport. Ride-sharing services like Uber and Lyft operate in Roswell but availability can be limited. Many hotels in Roswell offer complimentary shuttle pickup with advance reservation.
local_tip: If you have time between flights, drive 10 minutes north to the International UFO Museum and Research Center on Main Street — it is open daily and a uniquely Roswell experience.
